note: BIAN's part of SDEM's metamodel/archimate-notation.json — moved here with SDEM 0.22 (BX-15)

A2.BusinessArea.why: BIAN: a group of business domains — no behaviour of its own

A2.BusinessDomain.why: BIAN: a group of service domains

A2.ServiceDomain.why: BIAN: a discrete, non-overlapping business capability partition — behaviour grouped by function, so a Business Function

A2.ControlRecord.why: BIAN: the record a service domain keeps of what it controls — passive information

A2.ServiceGroup.why: BIAN: a group of a service domain's operations offered to others

A2.ServiceOperation.why: BIAN: one offered operation of a service domain

A2.FunctionalPattern.why: BIAN: the pattern of behaviour a service domain follows

A2.AssetType.why: BIAN: the kind of asset a service domain controls

A2.BehaviorQualifier.why: BIAN: a refinement of a service domain's behaviour

A2.BusinessScenario.why: BIAN: service domains working together on one business event

A2.BusinessObjectAttribute.why: a field of a business object — drawn inside it

A2.BOMModel.why: BIAN: the published form of the business object model

A2.Wireframe.why: BIAN: the published shape of an API

A2.SemanticAPI.why: BIAN: a service domain's published API, at the business level
